verdict.label: Light review
verdict.summary: You must register your own Microsoft Entra ID app because Composio does not provide a managed app for Microsoft Entra ID.

composioFit.summary: Composio requires a custom auth configuration for Microsoft Entra ID because no managed app is available in the catalog.
whyOwnApp: Composio-managed OAuth is not available for Microsoft Entra ID.
You must provide your own Client ID and Client Secret from your Microsoft Entra app registration.

phases.name: Register Application
steps: Sign in to the Microsoft Entra admin center.
Navigate to App registrations and select New registration.
Enter a meaningful Name and select the appropriate supported account types.
phases.handoff: Copy the Application (client) ID from the Overview page.

phases.name: Configure Redirect URIs
steps: Get the redirect URI from your Composio dashboard auth config.
Navigate to the Authentication page in your app registration.
Add the redirect URI for web applications.
phases.handoff: Paste Client ID and Client Secret into the Composio dashboard.

artefacts.title: Microsoft Entra App Registration Values
artefacts.body:
App Name: AI Agent Entra Integration
Supported account types: Accounts in any organizational directory and personal Microsoft accounts (or Single tenant depending on use case)
Redirect URI: <Composio callback URL from your auth config>

requirements.label: Privacy Statement
requirements.when: Required by terms of use for all applications accessing Microsoft Identity APIs.

requirements.label: Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program Account
requirements.when: Only required if you want to complete publisher verification to remove consent screen warnings.

scopes.purpose: Sign in and read user profile

redirectRules.rule: For Web and Single-page applications, you specify a redirect URI manually.

blockers.symptom: This browser is no longer supported. Upgrade to Microsoft Edge...
blockers.cause: Accessing Microsoft Learn documentation or certain legacy portals via an unsupported automated or embedded browser.
blockers.fix: Use a modern supported browser such as Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome.

blockers.symptom: Attempting to move an application object between different tenants.
blockers.cause: Once created, you can't move the application object between different tenants.
blockers.fix: Register a new application in the destination tenant.
blockers.fallback: Recreate app configuration in the new tenant.

blockers.symptom: Warning appears on the consent screen informing the user that the app was created by an unverified publisher.
blockers.cause: Using an unverified multi-tenant app requesting permissions beyond basic sign-in.
blockers.fix: Complete publisher verification using a Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program account.
blockers.fallback: Use single-tenant app registration if multitenancy is not strictly required.

checklist.text: Sign in to the Microsoft Entra admin center as an Application Developer.
Register a new application and record the Application (client) ID.
Create an auth config in the Composio dashboard to retrieve the redirect URI.
Add the Composio redirect URI to the Authentication settings of your app registration.
Generate a client secret in the Certificates & secrets section.
Paste Client ID and Client Secret into the Composio dashboard auth config.
